name: Yamada Hifumi
source:
An otaku who is a well-known doujinshi artist. Hifumi has a certain charisma within his industry and is proud of the following he's cultivated. At a local school festival, he was able to sell over 10,000 copies of his latest creation—a stunning achievement by any measure. He proclaims that his interests are solely in the "2D World".

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danganronpa]Wikipedia[/url] &  [url=http://danganronpa.us/danganronpa/characters.html#yamada]official description[/url]]
